_help: Windows version; see winxmerge-files.linux-macos.json for Linux/macOS. Mark 2 files for a 2-way compare or 3 files for a 3-way merge (base, left, right in list order), then pick this from the context menu. Replace <WINXMERGE_PATH> with wherever your copy of the tool lives. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
name: Compare in WinXMerge
